observations: Photo 0 shows a white outdoor unit of an air conditioner wrapped in plastic, with a remote control placed on top. The unit has a visible fan grille and a small black panel on the right side.
Photo 1 shows a top-down view of the same unit, with the remote control visible and the brand name 'SAMSUNG' faintly visible on the plastic wrap.
Photo 2 shows a side view of the unit, with the brand name 'SAMSUNG' clearly visible on the plastic wrap above the front grille. The unit is still wrapped in plastic and appears to be new or unused.
All photos show the unit in an outdoor setting, possibly a yard or storage area, with dirt and debris around. The unit is not installed and is resting on small metal feet.
The remote control is white and appears to be standard for a Samsung AC, with buttons and a small display.

claims.evidence: Brand name 'SAMSUNG' is visible on the plastic wrap in photo 1 and photo 2. The unit appears new and unworn, consistent with 'just arrived'.
Remote control is visible on top of the unit in photo 0, photo 1, and photo 2.
Unit is wrapped in plastic, showing no visible dirt or damage. The plastic wrap appears intact, indicating minimal handling.
No evidence of functionality is shown in the photos. The unit is not powered on, and no operation is demonstrated. Functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Unit may be non-functional or damaged internally despite external appearance
risks.proof: Video or photo of the unit powered on, showing fan operation, cooling, and remote control functionality.

risks.risk: Unit may be a refurbished or used unit misrepresented as new
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the serial number and model number on the unit's label, along with a photo of the original packaging or invoice if available.

risks.risk: Remote control may be non-functional or missing key components
risks.proof: Video of the remote control being used to power on the unit and adjust settings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as remote not included or non-functional

proof_requests: Video of the unit powered on, showing fan operation and cooling.
Close-up photo of the model and serial number label on the unit.
Video of the remote control being used to operate the unit.
Photo of the original packaging or invoice if available.
response.reason: The unit appears to be a new Samsung 1.5hp air conditioner with the remote, and the seller's claims are mostly supported by the photos. However, functionality cannot be verified remotely, and there are risks of internal damage or misrepresentation as new. Proof of operation and model details are required before pricing.
